# Applications 

## Temps réguliers


```{r}
# ============================================================================
# Visualisation des trajectoires sous H0 et H1
# ============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
set.seed(123)
# H0 : Processus de Wiener avec dérive 

t_reg <- seq(0, 50, by = 1)
n <- length(t_reg) - 1
mu_true <- 2
sigma_true <- 1.5
dt <- diff(t_reg)
dx_wiener <- rnorm(n, mean = mu_true * dt, sd = sigma_true * sqrt(dt))
x_wiener <- c(0, cumsum(dx_wiener))
X_wiener <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = x_wiener)

# H1 : Processus Gamma 

dx_gamma <- rgamma(n, shape = 0.5, rate = 0.5)
x_gamma <- c(0, cumsum(dx_gamma))
X_gamma <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = x_gamma)

# Graphique comparatif
ggplot() +
  geom_step(data = X_wiener, aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HWP"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_step(data = X_gamma, aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HGP"), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Trajectoires sous H0 et H1",
       x = "Temps", y = "Dégradation",
       color = "Processus") +
  theme_minimal()

```



```{r}
# Tests sur H0 (Wiener)

print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Shapiro"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "JarqueBera"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Lilliefors"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Agostino"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Anderson"))
print(gof.wp(X_wiener, "Cramer"))
```



```{r}
# Tests sur H1 (Gamma)


print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Shapiro"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "JarqueBera"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Lilliefors"))

print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Anderson"))
print(gof.wp(X_gamma, "Cramer"))

```





# Inspections irrégulières

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================================
# Paramètres
# ============================================================================

mu_true   <- 0.5
sigma_true <- 2.5
n_points  <- 50
T_max     <- 20

set.seed(23)

# ============================================================================
# H0 : Processus de Wiener homogène (HWP)
# ============================================================================

t_irr_wiener <- sort(runif(n_points, 0, T_max))

dt_irr_wiener <- diff(c(0, t_irr_wiener))

dx_irr_wiener <- rnorm(
  n_points,
  mean = mu_true * dt_irr_wiener,
  sd   = sigma_true * sqrt(dt_irr_wiener)
)

x_irr_wiener <- c(0, cumsum(dx_irr_wiener))

X_irr_wiener <- data.frame(
  t = c(0, t_irr_wiener),
  x = x_irr_wiener
)

# ============================================================================
# H1 : Processus Gamma homogène (HGP)
# ============================================================================

t_irr_gamma <- sort(runif(n_points, 0, T_max))

dt_irr_gamma <- diff(c(0, t_irr_gamma))

dx_irr_gamma <- rgamma(
  n_points,
  shape = 2 * dt_irr_gamma,
  rate  = 1
)

x_irr_gamma <- c(0, cumsum(dx_irr_gamma))

X_irr_gamma <- data.frame(
  t = c(0, t_irr_gamma),
  x = x_irr_gamma
)

# ============================================================================
# Graphique comparatif
# ============================================================================

ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(
    data = X_irr_wiener,
    aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HWP (H0)"),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    data = X_irr_wiener,
    aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HWP (H0)"),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = X_irr_gamma,
    aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HGP (H1)"),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    data = X_irr_gamma,
    aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HGP (H1)"),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Comparaison des trajectoires irrégulières sous H0 et H1",
    x = "Temps",
    y = "Dégradation",
    color = "Processus"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```

library(ggplot2)

mu_true <- 2
sigma_true <- 1.5

set.seed(46)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# H0 : Processus de Wiener homogène (HWP)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

t_irr_wiener <- sort(runif(100, 0, 20))
dt_irr_wiener <- diff(c(0, t_irr_wiener))

dx_irr_wiener <- rnorm(
  100,
  mean = mu_true * dt_irr_wiener,
  sd   = sigma_true * sqrt(dt_irr_wiener)
)

x_irr_wiener <- c(0, cumsum(dx_irr_wiener))

X_irr_wiener <- data.frame(
  t = c(0, t_irr_wiener),
  x = x_irr_wiener
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# H1 : Processus Gamma homogène (HGP)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

t_irr_gamma <- sort(runif(100, 0, 20))
dt_irr_gamma <- diff(c(0, t_irr_gamma))

dx_irr_gamma <- rgamma(
  100,
  shape = 1 * dt_irr_gamma,
  rate  = 2
)

x_irr_gamma <- c(0, cumsum(dx_irr_gamma))

X_irr_gamma <- data.frame(
  t = c(0, t_irr_gamma),

)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Graphique comparatif

ggplot() +
  
  geom_point(
    data = X_irr_wiener,
    aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HWP (H0)"),
    size = 2
  ) +
  
  geom_line(
    data = X_irr_wiener,
    aes(x = t, y = x, color = "HWP (H0)"),
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    data = X_irr_gamma,

# Points Observés  Vs Points Simulés

```{r}
#  Données 

set.seed(42)
t_obs <- c(0, 4.8, 4.81, 12.6, 25.4, 61, 88.7)
mu <- 2
sigma <- 1.5

sim_mat <- simulate_wiener_rwa(times = t_obs, mu = mu, sigma = sigma, nsim = 1)
x_obs <- sim_mat[, 1]

bridge <- wiener_bridge(X = x_obs, t = t_obs, sigma = sigma)

df_obs <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_obs, type = "Points observés")
t_reg <- seq(0, max(t_obs), by = bridge$teq)
df_sim <- data.frame(t = t_reg, x = bridge$new_obs, type = "Points simulés")

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = df_obs, aes(t, x, color = type), size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(data = df_sim, aes(t, x, color = type), shape = 16, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Points observés" = "red", "Points simulés" = "blue")) +
  labs(title = "Pont brownien : Points observés vs Points simulés",
       x = "Temps", y = "X(t)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        legend.title = element_blank())
```

# NHGP


```{r}
# HGP_reg
sim_Wiener_reg_ <- function(n, mu, sigma, tmax = 100) {
  t <- seq(0, tmax, length.out = n)
  dt <- diff(t)
  increments <- rnorm(n-1, mean = mu * dt, sd = sigma * sqrt(dt))
  x <- c(0, cumsum(increments))
  return(cbind(t, x))
}

# NHGP_reg
sim_Gamma_reg_ <- function(n, A, b, tmax = 100) {
  t <- seq(0, tmax, length.out = n)
  increments <- numeric(n-1)
  for (i in 2:n) {
    shape <- b * (A(t[i]) - A(t[i-1]))
    increments[i-1] <- rgamma(1, shape = shape, rate = 1)
  }
  x <- c(0, cumsum(increments))
  return(cbind(t, x))
}

# NHGP_irreg
sim_Gamma_irreg_ <- function(t_obs, A, b) {
  t_full <- c(0, t_obs)
  n <- length(t_full)
  increments <- numeric(n-1)
  for (i in 2:n) {
    shape <- b * (A(t_full[i]) - A(t_full[i-1]))
    increments[i-1] <- rgamma(1, shape = shape, rate = 1)
  }
  x <- c(0, cumsum(increments))
  return(cbind(t_full, x))
}
```


```{r}
# Trajectoires
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(23)

t_obs <- seq(0, 50, length.out = 100)
mu_true <- 2
sigma_true <- 1.5

A <- function(t) t^2
b_true <- 2
```


```{r}
# HWP
resultat_wiener <- simulate_wiener_rwa(times = t_obs, mu = mu_true, sigma = sigma_true, nsim = 1)
x_wiener <- resultat_wiener[, 1]
X_wiener <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_wiener, Processus = "Wiener (H0)")


# NHGP
resultat_gamma <- sim_Gamma_reg_(n = length(t_obs), A = A, b = b_true, tmax = 50)
x_gamma <- resultat_gamma[, 2]  # deuxième colonne = x
X_gamma <- data.frame(t = t_obs, x = x_gamma, Processus = "Gamma non homogène (H1)")

X_compare <- rbind(X_wiener, X_gamma)

ggplot(X_compare, aes(x = t, y = x, color = Processus)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Comparaison des trajectoires",
       x = "Temps", y = "Dégradation") +
  theme_minimal()
```




# Inspections régulières

```{r}
MC_test_wiener_reg_ <- function(N, scenario, n, tmax,
                                mu = NULL, sigma = NULL, a = NULL, b = NULL,
                                mu_log = NULL, sigma_log = NULL, A = NULL) {
  une_iter <- function(i) {
    if (!is.null(A) && !is.null(b)) {
      X <- scenario(n = n, A = A, b = b, tmax = tmax)
    } else if (!is.null(a) && !is.null(b)) {
      X <- scenario(n = n, a = a, b = b, tmax = tmax)
    } else if (!is.null(mu_log) && !is.null(sigma_log)) {
      X <- scenario(n = n, mu_log = mu_log, sigma_log = sigma_log, tmax = tmax)
    } else {
      X <- scenario(n = n, mu = mu, sigma = sigma, tmax = tmax)
    }
    colnames(X) <- c("t", "x")
    X <- as.data.frame(X)
    res_s <- gof.wp(X, "Shapiro")
    rej_s <- as.integer(res_s$p.value < 0.05)
    res_j <- gof.wp(X, "JarqueBera")
    rej_j <- as.integer(res_j$p.value < 0.05)
    res_l <- gof.wp(X, "Lilliefors")
    rej_l <- as.integer(res_l$p.value < 0.05)
    res_g <- gof.wp(X, "Agostino")
    rej_g <- as.integer(res_g$p.value < 0.05)
    res_a <- gof.wp(X, "Anderson")
    rej_a <- as.integer(res_a$p.value < 0.05)
    res_c <- gof.wp(X, "Cramer")
    rej_c <- as.integer(res_c$p.value < 0.05)
    c(Shapiro = rej_s, JarqueBera = rej_j, Lilliefors = rej_l,
      Agostino = rej_g, Anderson = rej_a, Cramer = rej_c)
  }
  res <- sapply(1:N, une_iter)
  taux <- rowMeans(res)
  return(taux)
}
```

# Inspections irrégulières

```{r}
MC_test_wiener_irreg_ <- function(N = 50, scenario, t_obs,
                                 mu = NULL, sigma = NULL, a = NULL, b = NULL,
                                 mu_log = NULL, sigma_log = NULL, A = NULL) {
  
  une_iter <- function(i) {
    if (!is.null(A) && !is.null(b)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, A = A, b = b)
    } else if (!is.null(a) && !is.null(b)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, a = a, b = b)
    } else if (!is.null(mu_log) && !is.null(sigma_log)) {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, mu_log = mu_log, sigma_log = sigma_log)
    } else {
      X <- scenario(t_obs = t_obs, mu = mu, sigma = sigma)
    }
    
    res_s <- gof.wp(X, "Shapiro")
    rej_s <- as.integer(res_s$p.value < 0.05)
    
    res_j <- gof.wp(X, "JarqueBera")
    rej_j <- as.integer(res_j$p.value < 0.05)
    
    res_l <- gof.wp(X, "Lilliefors")
    rej_l <- as.integer(res_l$p.value < 0.05)
    
    res_g <- gof.wp(X, "Agostino")
    rej_g <- as.integer(res_g$p.value < 0.05)
    
    res_a <- gof.wp(X, "Anderson")
    rej_a <- as.integer(res_a$p.value < 0.05)
    
    res_c <- gof.wp(X, "Cramer")
    rej_c <- as.integer(res_c$p.value < 0.05)
    
    c(Shapiro = rej_s, JarqueBera = rej_j, Lilliefors = rej_l, 
      Anderson = rej_a, Cramer = rej_c, Agostino = rej_g)
  }
  
  res <- sapply(1:N, une_iter)
  taux <- rowMeans(res)
  return(taux)
}
```
